_comment: Deal 3 arcane to any target; Starfall - if an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, INSTEAD deal 4. CONDITIONAL_EFFECT then/else is the correct shape for 'instead' (two effects gated on the same condition would deal 7). The Starfall condition reads the graveyard turn event recorded by Zone.add; it was the invented flag STARFALL_FLAG, which nothing set.
